surface_diagnostics.loo_note: Fixed RBF hyperparameters; spatially clustered samples. The legacy leave_one_design_out fields hold out one float-distinct record; grouped metrics remove all coordinates within 1e-8 normalized distance (connected groups) to avoid numerical near-duplicate leakage. Neither is a random/generalization guarantee or confidence interval.
surface_diagnostics.comparison_note: Scalar signed path-gap only, at COMSOL grid coordinates inside the PWE box and sample convex hull. PWE is interpolated: differences mix interpolation error and model/geometry/discretization differences. No pointwise-band, midband, or group-velocity validation is claimed.
surface_diagnostics.convex_hull_note: Inside the hull is geometric support, not a guarantee of interpolation accuracy.

audit_limitation: The new driver manifest did not freeze implementation hashes or include its own reviewed gate before launch. This is a post-launch independent audit, not retrospective preregistration. The unchanged inherited physics files are checked against the earlier multistart manifest.

interpolant_comparison.scope: Post-launch offline comparison only. No changes to the running worker, frozen proposal surface, physics or acceptance tolerance.
interpolant_comparison.limitations: Nonuniform adaptive data; grouped leave-one-out is not an independent spatial test set. Boundary extrapolation is reported separately, and piecewise-linear interpolation intentionally returns no prediction outside its hull. Better CV does not certify the 0.05 GHz tolerance. Alternative fits are not deployed by this comparison.

proposal_selection_benchmark.scope: Fit 58-record frozen RBF and choose all four starts on the 81x81 grid; excludes physics and source-audit I/O. One host under current load, not a controlled hardware benchmark.
